title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
狼大叔发现，最近找吃的真是越来越困难了。附近的小动物越来越少了。
今天狼大叔家附近新搬来了两户人家，狼大叔真是太幸运了。
他用望远镜反复观察，确认一户是母鸡，另外一户是三只小猪。
page_text_en:
Uncle Wolf realized that it was getting harder and harder to find food lately. There were fewer and fewer small animals nearby.
Today, two new households had moved near Uncle Wolf's home. Uncle Wolf was truly lucky.
He observed repeatedly through his telescope, confirming one household was a hen, and the other was three little pigs.
summary_zh: 狼大叔发现附近食物变少，正用望远镜观察新搬来的两户人家——一户是母鸡，另一户是三只小猪，他感到非常幸运。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
《三只小猪》的故事听过吧！有两只小猪笨透了，用稻草和树枝盖房子，故事里的狼很容易就把他们吃掉了。不过故事里的狼也够笨的，被第三只小猪设计了。
等着吧，三只小猪迟早要分开住的，而且其中两只一定很笨。他是聪明无比的狼，他要把三只小猪都给吃了。
狼大叔密切关注着母鸡和三只小猪的动静。
太好了，原来母鸡还有十几只鸡宝宝，等这群小鸡长大，他就有十几只红烧鸡可以吃了。
太好了，三只小猪开始盖房子了。呃……怎么和故事里讲的有些不一样，他们盖的是石头房子，并没有分开住。没关系，他还看过小红帽的故事呢！只要他化个妆，扮成猪外婆，照样把他们一只只吞进肚子。
page_text_en:
Have you heard the story of 'The Three Little Pigs'? Two of the pigs were incredibly foolish, building houses out of straw and sticks, and the wolf in the story easily ate them. But even that wolf was foolish, tricked by the third pig.
Wait and see, the three little pigs will eventually live separately, and at least two of them will be very foolish. He is a clever wolf, and he plans to eat all three little pigs.
The wolf uncle closely watches the hen and the three little pigs.
Great! The hen has about ten baby chicks. Once these chicks grow up, he'll have ten roasted chickens to eat.
Great! The three little pigs have started building their houses. Hmm... how come it's different from the story? They're building stone houses and aren't living separately. No problem, he's also read the story of Little Red Riding Hood! As long as he puts on makeup and dresses up as Grandma Pig, he can still eat them one by one.
summary_zh: 狼大叔在观察新搬来的母鸡和三只小猪，他计划利用它们作为食物，并打算伪装成猪外婆来吃掉小猪。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
母鸡一家和三只小猪，他们
谁离得近？谁离得远？
狼大叔站到楼顶上看了看，
好像三只小猪离得近。不过他还
是不能确定，他要去弄个明白。

只是，到底
先吃谁呢？
这样吧！他
肚子很饿的时候，
他就吃离得近一
些的那一家人；
肚子不那么饿的
时候，他就吃离
得远一些的那一
家子。
page_text_en:
The hen family and the three little pigs—
which one is closer? Which one is farther?
Wolf Uncle climbed to the rooftop to take a look.
It seemed the three little pigs were closer. But he still
wasn't sure. He had to find out for sure.

But, who should he eat first?
Here's the plan! When
he's very hungry,
he'll eat the family that's closer;
when he's not so hungry,
he'll eat the family that's farther away.
summary_zh: 狼大叔站在高处观察新搬来的母鸡一家和三只小猪，不确定谁离得更近，于是决定去弄清楚。他同时思考着先吃谁，并制定了根据饥饿程度选择目标的计划。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
想要知道谁近，谁远，可以用尺子量一量。
狼大叔把家里翻遍了，都没有找到尺子。没关系，没有尺子，他可以用脚量啊。走一走，数一数步子，就能知道谁离得近，谁离得远。
得等母鸡一家和三只小猪睡着了再进行，可不能让他们知道自己要吃他们。

终于到半夜，母鸡、小鸡和小猪应该都睡着了，可以开始量了。
“一步，两步，三步，四步，五步，六步……”
狼大叔一边走着，嘴里一边数着步子。
数清楚了，从他家到母鸡家是一千七百九十三步。
page_text_en:
To find out who is closer and who is farther, you can measure with a ruler.
Big Wolf searched his house thoroughly but couldn't find a ruler. No problem—without a ruler, he could measure with his feet. Walk and count the steps, and he'd know who is closer and who is farther.
He had to wait until the hen family and the three little pigs were asleep before starting, so they wouldn't know he planned to eat them.

Finally, at midnight, the hen, chicks, and pigs should all be asleep. It was time to start measuring.
"One step, two steps, three steps, four steps, five steps, six steps..."
Big Wolf walked along, counting steps aloud.
He counted it clearly: from his home to the hen's home was one thousand seven hundred and ninety-three steps.
summary_zh: 狼大叔为了确定母鸡家和小猪家谁离得更近，决定用脚步丈量距离。他在半夜悄悄出发，一边走一边数步，最终得出从自己家到母鸡家是1793步。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
呼呼，什么东西这么香？
狼大叔贴近母鸡的家门，从
门缝里看到母鸡正在做爆米花。
母鸡轻轻地哼着歌：“奶油
味的爆米花，咕噜咕噜冒出来了。”

母鸡把炸好的两桶爆米花
放在窗台上。
狼大叔悄悄抱走了一桶，
回家吃了个饱。
page_text_en:
Huh, what's that delicious smell?
Uncle Wolf crept up to the hen's door and, through the crack, saw the hen making popcorn.
The hen softly hummed, "Creamy popcorn, bubbling up!"

The hen placed two buckets of freshly made popcorn on the windowsill.
Uncle Wolf quietly took one bucket and
went home to eat his fill.
summary_zh: 狼大叔闻到母鸡家飘出的爆米花香味，从门缝看到母鸡正在制作爆米花，他趁机悄悄抱走一桶，回家饱餐一顿。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
第二天晚上，狼大叔又等到半夜。这次，他要去量一量从他家到三只小猪家有多远。

“一步，两步，三步，四步……”狼大叔一边走，嘴里一边数着步子。
终于数清楚了，是一千七百五十七步。
去母鸡家是一千七百九十三步，去小猪家是一千七百五十七步，哪个近？哪个远呢？
page_text_en:
The next night, Uncle Wolf waited until midnight again. This time, he was going to measure how far it was from his home to the three little pigs' house.

"One step, two steps, three steps, four steps..." Uncle Wolf walked along, counting each step out loud.
Finally, he counted it all: one thousand seven hundred and fifty-seven steps.
To the hen's house, it was one thousand seven hundred and ninety-three steps. To the pigs' house, it was one thousand seven hundred and fifty-seven steps. Which is closer? Which is farther?
summary_zh: 狼大叔在半夜测量从自己家到三只小猪家的距离，数出是1757步，并与之前测量的到母鸡家的1793步进行比较，思考哪个更近。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
狼大叔正在想答案的时候——
呼呼，什么香味？
狼大叔爬上围墙，看到三只小猪正在院子里煮
什么东西，锅子里咕噜咕噜冒着热气。
三只小猪轻轻哼着歌：“卤豆腐，美味的卤豆腐……”
原来锅子里做的是卤豆腐。
三只小猪煮好卤豆腐，还没吃，就在摇椅上睡
着了。狼大叔悄悄跳下围墙，大口大口吃了起来。
真是太好吃了！
就这样，狼大叔肚子饿的时候，就去三只小猪
家吃卤豆腐；肚子不是那么饿的时候，就去母鸡家
吃奶油味的爆米花。
至于母鸡一家和三只
小猪，他要把他们留下来，
当成以后的晚餐。
page_text_en:
While Wolf Uncle was thinking of the answer—
Huh? What's that smell?
Wolf Uncle climbed over the wall and saw three little pigs cooking something in the yard. The pot was bubbling with steam.
The three little pigs sang softly, "Stewed tofu, delicious stewed tofu..."
It turned out the pot was filled with stewed tofu.
The three little pigs had finished cooking the stewed tofu, but hadn't eaten it yet. They fell asleep in their rocking chairs. Wolf Uncle quietly jumped down the wall and began eating it in big bites.
It was so delicious!
This way, when Wolf Uncle was hungry, he would go to the three little pigs' house for stewed tofu; when he wasn't very hungry, he would go to the hen's house for creamy popcorn.
As for the hen family and the three little pigs, he planned to keep them for future dinners.
summary_zh: 狼大叔发现三只小猪正在煮卤豆腐，趁他们睡着时偷吃了一顿。他决定根据饥饿程度选择去小猪家吃卤豆腐或去母鸡家吃爆米花，并计划将母鸡一家和小猪留作以后的晚餐。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
这一天晚上，狼大叔又饿了，他要去三只小猪家吃卤豆腐吃个饱。
他来到三只小猪的家，听到“哎哟，哎哟”的叫声，只见一只小猪捂着肚子，在地上打滚。
是肚子疼吧？
狼大叔跑啊跑啊跑，两只小猪追啊追啊追……
咦？这是哪儿？
怎么是医院？
狼大叔扛起小猪飞快地跑。哪条路离得近呀？
“站住，你这个大坏蛋。”
两只小猪在后面拼命追喊。
原来狼大叔是送小猪来看医生的。
要是这只小猪死了，其他两只小猪就一定没心情煮东西吃。到时候，他上哪儿去吃那么好吃的卤豆腐呢？
page_text_en:
One night, Wolf Uncle was hungry again and planned to go to the Three Little Pigs' house to eat braised tofu until he was full.
He arrived at the Three Little Pigs' home and heard "Ouch, ouch!" He saw one little pig holding his stomach and rolling on the ground.
Is it a stomachache?
Wolf Uncle ran and ran, while the two little pigs chased and chased...
Huh? Where is this?
Why is it a hospital?
Wolf Uncle carried the little pig and ran quickly. Which way is closer?
"Stop! You big bad guy!"
The two little pigs chased and shouted behind him.
It turned out Wolf Uncle was taking the little pig to see a doctor.
If this little pig died, the other two would surely lose their appetite for cooking. Then, where would he go to eat such delicious braised tofu?
summary_zh: 狼大叔本想偷吃三只小猪的卤豆腐，却发现一只小猪肚子疼，便假装送它去医院，实则为了确保小猪们能继续做饭供他日后享用。

title_zh: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔
title_en: Near and Far: Lucky Wolf Uncle
source_file: 距离的远近：幸运的狼大叔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
狼大叔送小猪去医院，哪条路近一些？哪条路远一些呢？请给更远的那条路贴上星星。
母鸡家离狼大叔家近，还是三只小猪家离狼大叔家近，请给离得近的路铺上红色的地毯吧。
page_text_en:
Uncle Wolf is taking the little pig to the hospital. Which path is shorter? Which is longer? Please stick a star on the longer path.
Is the hen's home closer to Uncle Wolf's home, or is the three little pigs' home closer? Please lay a red carpet on the closer path.
summary_zh: 本页通过互动提问，让读者比较狼大叔家到母鸡家和三只小猪家的距离，并根据距离远近进行标记，同时画面描绘了狼大叔伪装成医生送小猪去医院的场景。
